CustomField.description: The scope actually handed to Database.executeBatch for this run, not the value configured on the job. Blank when the run did not start a batch. The two differ whenever a legacy Schedulable picks its own scope, which is why the configured value alone was never enough to explain a run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Records per batch actually used. Blank when this run started no batch.
CustomField.label: Records Per Batch
